name: ExcelForge
description: A Windows-based MCP server that enables AI assistants to manage Excel files through the desktop application, supporting workbook operations, data manipulation, and formula validation. It features robust safety tools including snapshot-based rollbacks, path restrictions, and comprehensive audit logging.
